feature.title: Replace print logging with structlog
feature.problem_statement: The codebase relies on print statements for logging, which lacks structure and consistency.
feature.user_story: As a developer, I want print-based logging replaced with structlog so logs are structured and consistent.
global_acceptance_criteria: No print statements remain in the codebase
Manual verification confirms logs appear as expected
constraints: Prefer placing logging configuration in the shared module unless a better location is identified
dependencies: structlog is available as a dependency (add to requirements if missing)

question_log.question: What is the user-visible goal of the feature (one sentence)?
question_log.answer: replace print based logging statements with structlog.

question_log.question: What are the concrete success criteria (bullets)?
Where should it live in the product (screens/routes/modules)?
question_log.answer: probably in the "shared" module, but I'm willing to entertain other suggestions if you feel there is a better option.

question_log.question: What is explicitly out of scope?
How should we verify it works (tests/commands/manual checks)?

work_items.title: Audit current print usage and target modules
work_items.scope: Identify all print statements and their intent (debug/info/error) to inform structlog usage.
outputs: Inventory of print statements with context and recommended log levels
implementation_notes: Use ripgrep or similar to list print calls
acceptance_criteria: All print statements are cataloged with file locations
Each print is mapped to an intended log level
verification_steps: Run search for print statements and confirm coverage
definition_of_done: Audit list exists and is complete
work_items.notes: Audit complete. 4 app-code prints to replace (3 warning, 1 error). 5 setup.py prints to keep as CLI output. See progress.txt for full inventory.

work_items.title: Add/confirm structlog dependency
work_items.scope: Ensure structlog is present in dependencies.
implementation_notes: If structlog is already present, no change needed
acceptance_criteria: structlog is declared in dependency management
verification_steps: Check dependency files for structlog entry
definition_of_done: Dependency state is correct and committed
work_items.notes: Added structlog>=24.1.0 to requirements.txt, setup.py (install_requires + py2app packages). Installed v25.5.0 in venv. All 79 tests pass.

work_items.title: Introduce shared structlog configuration
work_items.scope: Create or update a shared logging setup module for structlog.
implementation_notes: Expose a logger factory or configured logger
acceptance_criteria: Structlog is configured in shared module
Call sites can obtain a logger consistently
verification_steps: Import the shared logger in a simple module and ensure it logs
work_items.notes: If a better module exists, document the rationale and use it instead.

work_items.title: Replace print statements with structlog calls
work_items.scope: Update all print usage to use structlog with appropriate levels.
outputs: Structured logging calls across the codebase
acceptance_criteria: All previously identified print statements are replaced
verification_steps: Re-run search for print statements to confirm none remain
Run the app or scripts manually and confirm logs output
definition_of_done: No print statements remain in source
work_items.notes: If any print is required (e.g., CLI output), replace with appropriate logging or explicit stdout handling.

work_items.title: Manual verification and cleanup
work_items.scope: Confirm behavior and remove any temporary artifacts from the audit.
implementation_notes: Run the most common app entrypoints manually
verification_steps: Search for any remaining print statements
work_items.notes: Document any remaining questions or exceptions if found.
